rows.name: Swamp Monster
rows.notes: Swamp monster heard screaming and killing a deer then running off into the forest with green smoke coming off it

rows.name: Bigfoot
rows.notes: You can hear roars and chase him through the marshes and I came across a wicker man and passed out. Came too in the marshes

rows.name: Redneck Shooting Party
rows.notes: Two possibly intoxicated rednecks practising their aim in the middle of nowhere aaaaand.. you can join

rows.name: Mount Kalaga - Cycling Trial
rows.notes: Near the summit of Mount Kalaga

rows.name: Tiki Touchdown
rows.notes: A clothes free resort

rows.name: Plane crash
rows.notes: Plane crashed with a shipment of drugs > Collect it > Kill the NPCs > Watch out, cops are coming > Sell the drugs at Bayn’s warehouse

rows.name: Tree man
rows.notes: A humanoid-shaped tree surrounded by flowers that release spores; if you stay nearby for too long, a cutscene featuring a creature will be triggered.

rows.name: Store Hostage Rescue
rows.notes: Jason/Lucia encounters a vehicle with an open trunk and a blood trail leading into a dark building, where 2 men hold a store manager hostage. A unique shotgun can be found be found near the room inside.

X-Files Close Encounter
rows.notes: An abandoned car sits on the roadside, all doors wide open, emitting strange electronic noises. A trail of discarded clothes leads into the nearby woods. Follow it deeper into the forest to uncover a... weird encounter.

rows.name: Drunkard Asking for Money
rows.notes: Drunkark going around asking for money

rows.name: Plane Crash: Cocaine and Map
rows.notes: This is a crashed plane with a map to deliver the cocaine. 2 bundles of cocaine are located next to the plane

rows.name: Parachute (radio tower)
rows.notes: On top of the radio tower.

rows.name: Hijack a Robbery
rows.notes: A Mother and Daughter will be robbing the liquor store late at night; you can take their filled van off them and get about $1.5K from the back of the van. Van also has extra storage spots

rows.name: Cocaine Yacht
rows.notes: If you follow the map from the plane crash in Pellican Valley, you'll find the yacht where the plane was supposed to deliver cocaine. On board, some cash and cocaine to grab

rows.name: Traffic Stop: Drunk Steals Cop Car
rows.notes: A drunk guy is stopped by two cops and taunts them before hopping in a squad car to take it for a joy ride.

rows.name: Gas Redneck
rows.notes: A redneck ranting about the deep state is filling up a bathtub in a pickup truck bed with gasoline. He will spray it at the player if they get too close and will usually drive off and explode as he crashes somehow

rows.name: Smuggler Boat Explosion
rows.notes: Cocaine Smuggler Boat explodes around here. Easy $1.2k in drugs. Watch out for the sharks. Marker may need some adjusting but it’s roughly correct

rows.name: UFO Event: Suspicious Car
rows.notes: Find a car acting suspiciously, inspect the scene.

rows.name: Skunk Apeology 101
rows.notes: Speak to the stranger flying the drones.

rows.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
rows.notes: Help push the van out of the mud.

rows.name: Missing Wife
rows.notes: Help Alan Coleman find his wife after a car accident.

rows.name: Cocaine Yacht Shark Attack
rows.notes: As you boat through here you hear an explosion: a small boat is on fire after a shark attack. About 4 bags of cocaine float around it.

rows.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
rows.notes: Two men are stuck with their van in the mud: help push it out for $200.

rows.name: Witch of the Swamp
rows.notes: A woman called the Witch of the Swamp talks about the swamp and asks you to come back a few days later.

rows.name: Hunter Shoots His Friend
rows.notes: You hear a gunshot and find two hunters arguing. They ask you to take them to the Hamlet hospital.

rows.name: VR Gamer (house)
rows.notes: There's a gamer inside the house that's using VR to watch adult content. You get sound notification when you pass the house. There's a couple of other things to do here, a Smash 'n' Grab, unique vehicle in the garage and a Basketball hoop. There's also a safe beside the bed you can break open (one player found $1,100 in it). One player found a Luxury Watch (1 of 37) in the safe.

rows.name: Drug Deal
rows.notes: Multiple Cars and a fanboat parked around a stash bag and some gas cans at night. Flares are scattered around. Multiple weapons available and roughly $1.8k in drugs plus some cash.

rows.name: Investigate the Photos
rows.notes: (Investigation into the missing persons photos around the area.) The photos you found could be connected to the missing persons posters in Port Gellhorn. Workout where they were taken to find out if there's a connection.

rows.name: Yard Sale (Arthur Morgan hat)
rows.notes: There's a yard sale here with an Arthur Morgan hat

rows.name: Kingfishers Ambush on the Road
rows.notes: If you have done the robbery with donnie you might get this event where kingfisher ambush you on the highway while blocking the road and shooting at you

rows.name: Alien Witness
rows.notes: He says that he saw an alien in this location

rows.name: Exploding Smuggler Boat
rows.notes: A boat with cocaine explodes and the driver gets eaten by a shark. You can collect 3-4 packages cocaine per $400 each.

rows.name: Pelican Valley Hunting Spot
rows.notes: A hunting magazine said this is a good place to find American alligators and black foxes.

rows.name: Grassrivers Hunting Spot
rows.notes: A hunting magazine said this is a good place to find Leonida panthers.

rows.name: Big Pine Hunting Spot
rows.notes: A hunting magazine said this is a good place to find black bears.

rows.name: Bobcat Key Hunting Spot
rows.notes: A hunting magazine said this is a good place to find Leonida bobcats.

rows.name: Garage Band
rows.notes: Two dudes on garage

rows.name: Save the Cow
rows.notes: A well-dressed show cow escapes. Return her to her owner... or don't.

rows.name: Missing Person Poster
rows.notes: A missing person poster from Port Gellhorn, found under the floorboards of the RV with "no lives" spray-painted next to the door.

rows.name: Fortune Teller
rows.notes: A fortune teller: bad advice for $1, good advice for $5, great advice for $10, a secret for $100 and your future for $1,000.

rows.name: Save the Bear Protest
rows.notes: Protesters block the street to free a bear from the back of a van. Convince the driver to let it out: it is a polar bear, which you can shoot and send to Bret.

rows.name: Cool Dog on a Jet Ski
rows.notes: Jump off a boat in this area and swim for a moment until you hear a dog barking. Turn around to find a dog on a jet ski: hop on and he takes you to a dog island.

rows.name: Cigarette Trick
rows.notes: A man shows you a cigarette trick if you give him a cigarette.

rows.name: Trailer Girl (yacht)
rows.notes: The woman from the GTA 6 trailer, found on Mattia's yacht.

rows.name: Truck Stuck in the Mud
rows.notes: A truck stuck in the mud.

rows.name: Missing Person: Sunken Car
rows.notes: In a sunken car at the edge of the lake; only the rusted roof racks show above the water.

rows.name: Missing Person: Pink Car (PRTYGRL)
rows.notes: Find the pink car with the plate PRTYGRL, under another car, and open the trunk to find the body.

rows.name: Bear Encounter
rows.notes: A tourist confronted by a bear asks you what to do.

rows.name: Kitty Drug Bust
rows.notes: Police block the road while they raid a house.

rows.name: Caleb, the Drunk Tractor Driver
rows.notes: A drunk tractor driver asks you to drive him to Stacy, his ex-boss.

rows.name: People Jumping in the Water
rows.notes: A group asks you to jump into the water with them. You can accept or leave.

rows.name: Cigarette Trick (outdoor bar)
rows.notes: Give a cigarette to the man with long brown hair and sunglasses and he tries a trick. Seen at night at the outdoor bar.

rows.name: Stolen Tiger in Van
rows.notes: Two men with a stuck van. Open the van to find a stolen tiger.

rows.name: Hunter Shoots His Friend
rows.notes: You hear gunshots and find two hunters: one shot his friend, mistaking him for a deer. Get both into your vehicle and drive them to the nearest hospital before the wounded hunter gets worse.

rows.name: Mandy Filming Her Neighbor
rows.notes: Meet Mandy in front of a yellow house, next to a small blue cottage. She is secretly filming her naked neighbor.

rows.name: Brofile Pic
rows.notes: Three guys drinking on top of the Wonder Whale ask you to take a picture of them.

rows.name: Skunk Ape Effigy
rows.notes: One of the three skunk ape effigies.

rows.name: Skunk Ape Effigy
rows.notes: One of the three skunk ape effigies.

rows.name: Robbed at the ATM
rows.notes: A man in a floral shirt pulls a gun as you start a deposit and demands all your cash. Hand it over, or refuse and he tries to kill you.

rows.name: Skunk Ape Effigy
rows.notes: One of the three skunk ape effigies.

rows.name: Drunk Man at the Rusty Anchor
rows.notes: A drunk man stumbles outside the Rusty Anchor asking for cash. Give him money for a ride home, or watch him water the plants and drive off drunk in his boat.

rows.name: Gellhorn Hunting Spot
rows.notes: A hunting magazine marks this as a good spot for wild boars, wild white turkeys, Leonida panthers and black foxes. Recommended weapon: Shrewsbury SM-69 rifle.

rows.name: Dumpster Diver
rows.notes: During Chapter 2, a dumpster diver at the motel where Jason and Lucia are staying.

rows.name: A Couple's Dream
rows.notes: A couple near the motel's reception entrance, dreaming about their future.

rows.name: Payday Loan Crashout
rows.notes: Inside Cash Flow Loans on Gellhorn Avenue, Port Gellhorn: a bald man rages at the ATM and cracks its screen.

rows.name: Iguana Target Practice
rows.notes: Three "ecologists" are shooting pumpkins. They challenge you to a $250 contest: shoot the most iguanas after they release them from a cage.

rows.name: Alien Encounter
rows.notes: A car sits on the road with all doors open, headlights flashing and a glitching radio. Further along, a bright light in a field: a naked middle-aged woman being beamed up by a tractor beam.

rows.name: Mudslider Mechanic
rows.notes: A mechanic fixing his car for the mudslide race asks you to sit in the driver's seat and rev the engine a few times until it is fixed.

rows.name: Fox Furry Cornered by Police
rows.notes: A man in a fox costume cornered by the police.

rows.name: Swamp Meditation
rows.notes: On the wooden dock by the lookout tower in the middle of Buckskin Swamp. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia (2 of the 18 meditations). A boat or airboat is the easiest way to get there.

rows.name: Plane Crash (highway)
rows.notes: Driving on the highway you see a small plane trailing black smoke. Follow it to where it crashes on the nearby hill.

rows.name: UFO Believer (Human Sibling)
rows.notes: A man standing on the hood of his pickup talks to you about UFOs. May only appear after the nearby UFO encounter.

rows.name: Influencer Livestreaming on Bridge
rows.notes: A man on the bridge is livestreaming.

rows.name: Undercover Cop Torture
rows.notes: In this warehouse two men are torturing a tied-up plain-clothes police officer. Listen in, or kill them and untie the cop.

rows.name: Polar Bear Activists
rows.notes: Activists trying to free polar bears.

rows.name: Car Accident
rows.notes: A car crash with a bag you can steal.

rows.name: Stash Bust
rows.notes: Cops have seized $1,200 of product. Kill them to take the bag and sell it at Dunks.

rows.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
rows.notes: A vehicle stuck by the water, the driver asks for help. Open the back door: a tiger jumps out and eats him.

rows.name: The Ritual of Sacrifice
rows.notes: Inside the building there is an icon: bring a human corpse to it to start a mini-quest.

rows.name: Shirley, the Neighbor
rows.notes: Shirley offers two side jobs during the chapter: bring her a bottle of rum, and steal her friend's scooter. In return you may use her car.

rows.name: Jason's House Meditation
rows.notes: Chapter 1 only (missable): after a morning talk in the kitchen, follow Lucia to the balcony with the training equipment and accept her offer to meditate. Counts as 1 of the 18 meditations.

rows.name: Smooth Sand Meditation
rows.notes: On a small sandbar off the west coast of Capri, north of Belpoint. Swim or take a boat. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

rows.name: Worn Stone Meditation
rows.notes: At the water's edge of the Emerald River at Camp Moonflower. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

rows.name: Red Rocks Meditation
rows.notes: In Manifest Canyon, near where the railway crosses the highway. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

rows.name: Water Wheel Meditation
rows.notes: By the old water wheel on the river, next to the ruins of the Lawton Co. Paper Mill in south Moreau. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

rows.name: Jutting Cliff Meditation
rows.notes: In Mount Kalaga National Park, on a cliff by a tower overlooking a mine, north of Kalaga Reservoir. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

rows.name: Waterfall Meditation
rows.notes: Northwest of Tallaloko, on a river overlooking a waterfall. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

rows.name: Seaside Meditation
rows.notes: On a rocky outcrop on the beach east of Waning Sands. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

rows.name: Ascent Meditation
rows.notes: The final meditation, in the stone circle at the summit of Mount Kalaga. It only appears on the map after you have done all the other meditations, and needs both Jason and Lucia.

rows.name: Merman Encounter
rows.notes: A man in a mermaid tail lies on the beach, livestreaming. He allows at least 2 selfies; take more for a surprise.

rows.name: Skunk Ape Effigy
rows.notes: A tribal statue made of wood and plants, painted in bright colors.

rows.name: Wounded Hunter
rows.notes: A hunter has been shot and needs to be taken to hospital.

rows.name: Junkie Car Theft
rows.notes: A junkie asks you to help her steal a car.

rows.name: Warehouse Hostage
rows.notes: Two men are holding a man hostage in the warehouse.

rows.name: Stranded Race Driver
rows.notes: A race driver has broken down on the side of the road and asks for a ride to a race before it's too late.

rows.name: Store Hostage Rescue
rows.notes: A vehicle with an open trunk and a trail of blood leading into the building, where M7 are beating and torturing the manager.

rows.name: Farm Wife Asking for Help
rows.notes: A woman in a robe with a flashlight asks you to help her husband, who has had an accident, in their house.

rows.name: Car Accident (truck crash)
rows.notes: A Sahara Mirage truck crashes into a car. The driver asks you to lie for him and promises you money if he gets a settlement.

rows.name: Tutsi the Cow
rows.notes: Catch Tutsi the cow.

rows.name: Captive Ex-Cop
rows.notes: Free the captured ex-cop.

rows.name: Parachute (Effluvia roof)
rows.notes: Parachute box on the Effluvia rooftop.

rows.name: Beefslap
rows.notes: A man is standing on top of his broken-down car.

rows.name: Yard Sale (Gary the alligator)
rows.notes: A lady holds a yard sale with an alligator named Gary.

rows.name: Being Hunted
rows.notes: You get tranquilized and wake up in a storage container, where you have to fight for your life.

rows.name: Hotspot - Atlantic Spadefish
rows.notes: Part of Cal's fishing quest.

rows.name: Cop Interrogated by Criminals
rows.notes: Criminals are interrogating a cop.

rows.name: Burning Car Collision
rows.notes: Two cars have collided and one is burning. The black pickup has a large chest in its bed with cocaine, cash and a Zhang Wu Type 9.

rows.name: Kitty Litter Drug Ring
rows.notes: A woman produces Kitty Litter, a synthetic drug. If you pass through, you have to wait until the police finish their operation.

rows.name: AI Ex-CEO
rows.notes: May only appear at night.

rows.name: Ghost Woman
rows.notes: Drive here at night: your car shuts off and a ghost woman crawls towards you, then appears in your car or as you get out.

rows.name: Ghost Ship (lighthouse)
rows.notes: Go to the lighthouse at night: you hear voices and see ghosts that leave clues to a cursed knife in the ocean. With the knife, climb to the top of the lighthouse and face the ocean: the ghost ship appears.

rows.name: Bridge Jumpers
rows.notes: A couple of kids jump off the bridge. Challenge them and choose to jump together, and there is more to this encounter.

rows.name: Drunk Tractor Driver
rows.notes: A drunk man asks you to help him drive his tractor.

rows.name: Carjacker at Gunpoint
rows.notes: A stranger gets into your car, holds a gun to your head and makes you drive.

rows.name: Gasoline Bath
rows.notes: A man is filling his bathtub with gasoline.

rows.name: Gang Revenge
rows.notes: Witness a drive-by shooting: gang retaliation in which a rival member (an M7 recruit) is killed.

rows.name: Insurance Fraud
rows.notes: After an accident, a man in a burning car: help him and it turns into insurance fraud.

rows.name: Bear Protesters (animal transport)
rows.notes: Protesters block a truck carrying a live bear.

rows.name: Crop Dusting Job (McKittrick Farm)
rows.notes: A job posting at the Starlet Motel says to call Kyle at McKittrick Farm: he has a crop dusting job.

rows.name: Taser Arrest
rows.notes: A man climbs onto a police car, gets tasered and is arrested.

rows.name: Anti-Theft Car
rows.notes: Steal the car and its anti-theft system takes over: it locks the doors and windows and drives you to the police station.

rows.name: Gang Trade
rows.notes: Only at night: two gangs meet to trade goods. Ambush them and take the loot (around $1,500).

rows.name: Drunk Man on a Police Car
rows.notes: A drunk man dances on a police car while officers try to handle him.

rows.name: Paranoid Prepper's Bunker
rows.notes: Move the container to reach the bunker, and watch out for mines: a paranoid man sets you more challenges for money.

rows.name: Roadside Forest Fire
rows.notes: Off the left side of the highway, a patch of trees is on fire.

rows.name: Clumsy Car Thief
rows.notes: A clumsy woman needs your help stealing a car.

rows.name: Botched Robbery
rows.notes: Robbers flee the payday loan store, dropping wads of cash on the tarmac as the owner chases them; the cash is left scattered around.

rows.name: Attempted Carjacking
rows.notes: At night a muscle car blocks the road and its driver demands money.

rows.name: Kolt & Associates Highway Ambush
rows.notes: After completing the chapter 2 mission "Slam Dunk" and gain the ability to raid their drug operations you'll be able to unlock this random encounter as they try to retaliate via an ambush. They will run the car off the road and try to kill you.

rows.name: Former Final Chapter Member Attacked
rows.notes: A former Final Chapter member is being beaten and threatened. Help him and untie him to complete it.

rows.name: Newlyweds' House
rows.notes: Listen in on a couple who have just got married.

rows.name: Kidnapped Cop
rows.notes: Two people have tied up a police officer.

rows.name: Dirty Cops (hangar)
rows.notes: Inside the hangar at 3 a.m.: a cop tied to a chair is beaten up by two dirty cops.

rows.name: Lady with a Couch
rows.notes: Help the woman with her couch and you get kidnapped into the game's take on the Saw movies.

rows.name: Influencer Falls from Overpass
rows.notes: A streamer livestreaming on the edge of the bridge accidentally falls off.

rows.name: Drug Export Threat
rows.notes: Two men are threatening another man. Question them and they tell you to back off; talk more with the threatened man.

rows.name: Traffic Stop: Golf Clubs
rows.notes: A woman is pulled over and her car searched; the police only find golf clubs.

rows.name: Corrupt Cops Rob a Dealer
rows.notes: Two corrupt cops beat a drug dealer and steal his cocaine, which opens a possible robbery.

rows.name: Loose Pet Tiger
rows.notes: Kingfishers gang members are mauled by a loose tiger. Shoot it, then fight the gang members who arrive.

rows.name: Linda's Coupon Meltdown
rows.notes: Linda, the motel receptionist, tries to get a restaurant coupon accepted, is refused and blows up at the staff.

rows.name: Man Tied Up in a Barn
rows.notes: A man yells for help, guarded by two thugs. After you save him, there is a shotgun in the back of their truck.

rows.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
rows.notes: Help push the stuck van (reward: adrenaline).

rows.name: Non-Flusher Movement QR Code
rows.notes: Scan the QR code with WAiNK and answer the Non-Flusher Movement message: it unlocks the side mission to meet a contact at Frank's Waffles in Tequesta, Vice-Dale County.

rows.name: Creepy Neighbour Zach
rows.notes: Zach is poking a dead animal with a tree branch; call him out and see what happens.

rows.name: ATV Rally
rows.notes: A crowd watches ATVs jump one of the stunt jumps, and you are invited to take part: a guy challenges you to jump over the concession building for $500.

rows.name: Car Jacking Lesson
rows.notes: Help a woman break into a locked car and steal it.

rows.name: Overpass Vandals (computers)
rows.notes: Three rednecks throw computers at cars from the highway overpass. You can scare them off.

rows.name: Delirious Farmer
rows.notes: A farmer driving his tractor in circles.

rows.name: Overpass Droppings
rows.notes: Three people throw tyres and junk off the overpass. Confront them and they back off quickly.

rows.name: Drive-Through Rant (Pollo Diablo)
rows.notes: A woman ranting about cheese at the drive-through window.

rows.name: Caveman vs Panther
rows.notes: After the caveman deals with a panther, he challenges you to a race.

rows.name: Man vs Bear
rows.notes: Tell the man to scare the bear off and he survives and promises to send you money.

rows.name: Sal, Shooting Victim
rows.notes: Sal was shot by people trying to rob his wallet. He needs a ride and help with something.

rows.name: Package Delivery
rows.notes: Deliver 3 packages for a broken-down Sahara driver.

rows.name: Alien Aficionado
rows.notes: A man waiting to see something: keep the conversation going.

rows.name: Lady with a Broken Car
rows.notes: A woman with a damaged car refuses help and gets aggressive. There is a stash in the trunk.

rows.name: Dumpster Man
rows.notes: An attorney asks for pills. If you give him pills, he gives you legal advice.

rows.name: Influencer (antenna)
rows.notes: At the top of the antenna, an influencer girl takes photos.

rows.name: Grayson Hunting Spot
rows.notes: A good place to find black bears and wild boars.

rows.name: Drug Boat Crash
rows.notes: A drug boat drives in circles and blows up, dropping cocaine.

rows.name: Gasoline Bath
rows.notes: A hillbilly fills a tub with gas in the bed of his truck, argues with the gas station clerk, then speeds off.

rows.name: Revenge on Kolt Associates
rows.notes: Sal, who shot himself, asks you to get revenge on Booker at Kingpin Bowling.

rows.name: Animal Crackers - Grayson
rows.notes: An Animal Crackers race, starting next to the Farm Tour and Red Canyon Run races.

rows.name: Disgruntled Employee
rows.notes: In Huck's Pump N Go you're recognised as one of the couple that robs stores all around Leonida.

rows.name: Paleo Bro
rows.notes: A man who wants to fight a panther tries to assert his dominance over it.

rows.name: The Ghost of Rockledge Rd
rows.notes: Driving down Rockledge Road at night, a ghostly figure runs across the road.

rows.name: Influencing Gone Fatal
rows.notes: Two rednecks film Jason or Lucia making fun of you; when you confront them they pull out their guns.

rows.name: Mistaken Identity ($2,000)
rows.notes: A man mistakes you for someone else and asks you for $2,000.

rows.name: Parachute
rows.notes: On top of the tower.

rows.name: Polar Bear Protest (freeway)
rows.notes: A group of activists protest on the freeway for the release of a polar bear.

rows.name: Couch Trap
rows.notes: Help a woman with a couch, get knocked out and wake up in a shipping container on an island.

rows.name: Zeke Pimple: Target Practice
rows.notes: Two dudes want to challenge your shooting skills.

rows.name: Boar Rams a Man
rows.notes: A boar runs out of the forest and rams a man.

rows.name: Moreau Hunting Spot
rows.notes: A good place to find black bears and black foxes.

rows.name: The San Fierro Tourist
rows.notes: Near the entrance to a mineshaft, a tourist from San Fierro runs away, scared of being attacked.

rows.name: Toilet Talk
rows.notes: Wyman talks with the plumber about the toilets.

rows.name: Dodos Rising
rows.notes: Activists protest against animal abuse: a polar bear is locked in the truck.

rows.name: Overheard Conversation (chimney)
rows.notes: At the back, under the chimney, you can hear a conversation from inside.

rows.name: Overheard Conversation (clinic)
rows.notes: On the left side, in the clinic, by the elevator.

rows.name: Gang Car Crash
rows.notes: Gangsters roll their car over and are then killed by the police. Pick up the loot bag afterwards.

rows.name: Mobility Scooter Robber
rows.notes: A woman on a mobility scooter steals a tourist's wallet, then tries to mug you.

rows.name: Parachute
rows.notes: A box of parachutes at the south-east end of the rooftop walkway.

rows.name: Insurance Fraud (van crash)
rows.notes: A van crashes into a car. The man fakes an insurance claim and asks you to be his witness for a payout.

rows.name: Parachute
rows.notes: A box of parachutes on the rooftop walkway, north side of the roof.

rows.name: Kingfisher Intimidation
rows.notes: Camo Kingfisher pickup rolls up to harass and threaten random man in parking lot. Their mad that he blew them off and didnt show up, they say. After they leave I question the man who got harassed and he reveals a Kingfisher Robbery opportunity on an island 1.69m north of Ammu-Nation parking lot.

rows.name: Police Raid
rows.notes: Three or four police cars and a riot squad raid the building.

rows.name: Mushroom Trip (stamina boost)
rows.notes: Eat the mushrooms to enter a trance and run an obstacle course. Finishing it improves your stamina.

rows.name: Rescue the Girl from Dru Kol
rows.notes: Get back in your car from going in the gas station to find her in the backseat. Drive her back to Gellhorn, raid the Kolt warehouse (4/5 enemies, suppressed weapon recommended) and then break the safe and collect the cash dotted around the warehouse. Take is about $6k.

rows.name: Assassination
rows.notes: A man shoots his opponent and runs off.

rows.name: Parachute (Flash FM transmitter)
rows.notes: At the top of the Flash FM radio transmitter.

rows.name: Wanted Posters (side mission)
rows.notes: Two wanted posters next to the front entrance of the Xero Food Mart. Examine them to unlock a side mission.

rows.name: Bud the Alien Hunter
rows.notes: Around 19:00 you hear "woo woo" shouts: Bud stands on top of his car, hoping to draw aliens and take a picture of them.

rows.name: Tigers in the Garages
rows.notes: There is a tiger in each of the garages of this house.

rows.name: Drugged Robber
rows.notes: A man on drugs holds up his friend at the convenience store.

rows.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
rows.notes: Push the van out of the mud.

rows.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
rows.notes: Help push the van out of the mud.

rows.name: Caravan Fight
rows.notes: Knock on the caravan door enough times and the man inside comes out to fight.

rows.name: Jumbo the Gator
rows.notes: While you are in the store a gator comes through the door. The clerk calls him Jumbo and asks you to feed him a hot dog.

rows.name: Strange Voice in the Sewer
rows.notes: At the corner of SE 2nd Ave, by the sewer grate next to the street-name pole.

rows.name: Killer Clown (elevator)
rows.notes: Take the second elevator: a killer clown jumps out, then disappears, leaving a coupon for a free pair of underpants.

rows.name: Junkie Kicked Out of a Trap House
rows.notes: A junkie gets thrown out of a trap house over unpaid debts, which opens up a chance to rob the place.

rows.name: M7 Gang Initiation
rows.notes: A gang initiation: a victim lies on the ground and is being beaten.

rows.name: Biker Gang Execution
rows.notes: Two biker gang members take the vest (cut) from a former member who wants to leave the gang, then shoot him dead.

rows.name: Banana Robbery
rows.notes: A guy holds up this farm market with a banana: defuse the situation or cheer him on.

rows.name: Rich Man Attacked by a Bear
rows.notes: Up on the hill. Drive slowly along the road until he screams, then use focus mode to find where the sound comes from.

rows.name: Corrupt Cops Rob a Dealer
rows.notes: Corrupt cops confiscate drugs from a dealer.

rows.name: Police Drug Bust
rows.notes: The police arrest a man carrying drugs and put him in the police car. Steal the car and let him go once you lose the heat.

rows.name: Street Percussionist
rows.notes: A percussionist plays to liven up the locals, but not everyone around here likes it.

rows.name: Peak Productivity Brother
rows.notes: A crazy guy rants about maximum productivity from inside his house, hiding by the window.

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: A voice calls from behind the trailer: a lawyer inside the dumpster asks for any kind of pills.

rows.name: VR Gamer
rows.notes: A man thinks he is alone with his VR headset on.

rows.name: Handcuffed Cop
rows.notes: A handcuffed cop: free him.

rows.name: Vicki's Phone Call with Mom
rows.notes: Overhear Vicki complaining to her mom about how creepy her boss Frankie acts around her; Lucia talks with her about him.

rows.name: Paleo Bro
rows.notes: A gym bro on the paleo diet taunts a panther, then scares it off with his urine.

rows.name: Blow Dart Kidnapping (side mission)
rows.notes: Only as Jason: approach the wooden box on the beach, get hit by a blow dart and kidnapped, then survive.

rows.name: Zeke Pimple: Target Practice
rows.notes: Join Pimple and his friend for target practice.

rows.name: Carjackers at Gunpoint
rows.notes: A couple stops in front of you and threatens you with guns to hand over the car.

rows.name: Police Car Theft
rows.notes: Someone steals a police car, leaving behind a Mustang-style car with the keys in it.

rows.name: Gas Station Drug Stop
rows.notes: The cops pull a man over, find a bag of cocaine and start interrogating him.

rows.name: Thieving Dog
rows.notes: A dog starts barking on the coast: follow it to a stash with a watch, then it follows you for a while.

rows.name: Overpass Tyre Throwers
rows.notes: Three kids on the bridge throw a tyre at cars passing on the highway.

rows.name: Linda's Night Warning
rows.notes: At night, Linda pounds on the door to give Chester and Shanese a final warning about their loud music.

rows.name: Man Stuck on a Dirt Road
rows.notes: A man stuck on the dirt road asks for help.

rows.name: Snake in the Trunk
rows.notes: A snake comes out of the trunk of the car.

rows.name: Gym Bro Choke Challenge
rows.notes: A guy bets you $1,000 that you can't choke him out. Choke him fully and you can loot the money, or stop early for more interaction.

rows.name: Broken-Down Mobster
rows.notes: An old-school Liberty City mobster with a broken-down '85 Albany Emperor. A member found cash and a Wortham W-10 in the trunk.

rows.name: Police Raid (garage)
rows.notes: Let it play out, then search the garage for a lockbox with $500+ inside.

rows.name: Ghost of Rockledge Rd (car)
rows.notes: At night, as you get into your vehicle, the Rockledge Rd ghost lunges at you from the back seat.

rows.name: Drive-By Shooting
rows.notes: Gang members gun down two people in a drive-by.

rows.name: Drive-Thru Drama
rows.notes: A woman at the drive-thru starts a fight because she wants extra cheese: provoke or calm the situation.

rows.name: Corrupt Cops Shake Down a Driver
rows.notes: The cops pull a man over and take an envelope full of his cash.

rows.name: Car Thief at the Gym
rows.notes: When you leave the gym, a thief tries to start your car.

rows.name: Abandoned Vehicle Fire
rows.notes: A car about to burst into flames and a truck next to it; the black trunk in the truck bed holds a half-brick of cocaine and a weapon.

rows.name: ATM Scam
rows.notes: After you take money out of the ATM, a woman asks you for $500.

rows.name: Old Lady Robber
rows.notes: An old lady on a mobility scooter robs people outside Jeb's Snack Bar.

rows.name: Jimmy the Drunk Sea Captain
rows.notes: Jimmy wanders around the bar rambling at customers with his speargun.

rows.name: Jimmy Figg Robbery
rows.notes: In the final chapter, Jimmy Figg can be robbed here.

rows.name: Thieves Crash Their Car
rows.notes: Thieves crash their car and run, leaving a bag and a weapon behind.

rows.name: Drag Queen Sobriety Test
rows.notes: Police give a drag queen a sobriety test.

rows.name: Animal Services Protest
rows.notes: Protesters stop a Leonida Animal Services truck to free a bear inside.

rows.name: Couch Trap
rows.notes: Two women ask for help moving a sofa. If you help, you're drugged and wake up in a death trap.

rows.name: UFO Van Abduction
rows.notes: A van hangs in mid-air under a UFO, then drops back to the ground after a burst of light.

rows.name: Helping Hunters
rows.notes: A man shot his friend, who wears antlers on his head, and asks for a ride to the hospital.

rows.name: Helping Hunters
rows.notes: A hunter in a deer costume got shot and needs a lift to the hospital. Reward: the Laird 350 "Hunter" rifle.

rows.name: Zeke & Pimple: Target Practice (2nd spot)
rows.notes: Another spot where Zeke and Pimple practise shooting. Talk to them to try it.

rows.name: Ghost Encounter
rows.notes: Beat up the car to get the trophy The Truth Is Out There.

rows.name: Police Bust (Kolt Associates)
rows.notes: Police are arresting Kolt Associates and trying to get to the safe. Empty it before they do.

rows.name: Couple Carjacking
rows.notes: A couple who look like Jason and Lucia try to steal your car at gunpoint.

rows.name: Apple Shot (ride to the race track)
rows.notes: A man asks for a ride to the race track nearby, where you play a round of Apple Shot.

rows.name: Thieving Dog (watch)
rows.notes: A barking dog with a wallet in its mouth leads you to a valuable watch.

rows.name: Sahara Van Crash (lawsuit)
rows.notes: A man gets T-boned by a Sahara van and plans to sue. Talk to him to get a cut as a witness.

rows.name: Street Race Challenge
rows.notes: Someone challenges you to a street race on the highway.

rows.name: Give Two Girls a Ride Home
rows.notes: Two girls ask for a ride home.

rows.name: Bikini Robbery
rows.notes: Two women in bikinis rob the pawn shop and fall through the ceiling. Help them out and rob the place yourself.

rows.name: Man in the Sewer
rows.notes: Go to the sewer drain between the two trees.

rows.name: Cargo Thieves
rows.notes: Two guys steal from the poolside bar on the shore.

rows.name: Jewelry Store Heist
rows.notes: Four men on bikes rob the store. Follow them to a nearby alley to take their loot.

rows.name: Apple Shot (Beefslap)
rows.notes: If you give Beefslap a ride, you play a round of Apple Shot.

rows.name: Alien Conspiracy Ranter
rows.notes: A man on a truck shouts about aliens and Area 69.

rows.name: Caden O (Influencer on the Bridge)
rows.notes: An influencer chases online clout by walking on the bridge. You can help him.

rows.name: PTT Youngin$ Car Crash
rows.notes: Gang members crash their car and run from the police, leaving a stash bag and a unique gun.

rows.name: Homeless Woman Car Theft
rows.notes: A homeless woman tries to steal a car: help her or refuse.

rows.name: Car Crash with Stash Bag
rows.notes: A car flips in front of you and a stash bag falls out of the boot: about $1,800.

rows.name: Drowning Streamer
rows.notes: A streamer needs help: he is drowning.

rows.name: Quick Mug
rows.notes: A man is mugged in his car in this alley; there is a small stash in his trunk.

rows.name: Van Stuck in the Mud (tiger)
rows.notes: Another spot for the van stuck in the mud with a tiger in the back.

rows.name: Bayside Apartments Gossip
rows.notes: Ground-floor neighbours chat about the other residents; stay close to hear their stories.

rows.name: Mines Encounter
rows.notes: After connecting the dots between all the bodies in Port Gellhorn, a mysterious encounter waits here.

rows.name: Drug Stop Arrest
rows.notes: Police arrest a man for drugs "for personal use".

rows.name: Vagrant Informant
rows.notes: By the fire pit, a vagrant chases you down with information you can pay for.

rows.name: Night Plane Drop
rows.notes: At night, a plane lands and trades with the local gang.

rows.name: Sahara Truck Crash
rows.notes: A Sahara work truck hits a car and traps the driver. You can help them get out.

rows.name: Car Theft at Status Auto Imports
rows.notes: A gang steals cars from Status Auto Imports.

rows.name: Rottweiler vs Iguana
rows.notes: A Rottweiler on a leash barks at a full-grown green iguana.

rows.name: Ghost Woman (car)
rows.notes: The headlights flicker, the car stops, and a female ghost runs at you on all fours.

rows.name: Self-Driving Car Security System
rows.notes: Steal the red Coil Raiden: after a few meters it drives itself and its security system goes off.

rows.name: Cigarette Trick
rows.notes: A man asks you for a cigarette.

rows.name: Harper Hiding in Your Car
rows.notes: Harper hides in your car because she is being followed, and asks for a ride to a garage.

rows.name: Sunshine the Aura Reader
rows.notes: A woman named Sunshine does aura readings in the parking lot.

rows.name: Couch Trap
rows.notes: A woman asks for help putting a couch in her car, then kidnaps you for a deadly game.

rows.name: Helping Hunters
rows.notes: A hunter accidentally shoots his friend, who wears deer antlers.

rows.name: Delivery Van Crash
rows.notes: A crashed delivery van by the highway: deliver the three remaining packages and send photos as proof.

rows.name: Sahara Van Crash (car on fire)
rows.notes: A Sahara van crashes into a car, which catches fire with the driver trapped inside: help him or not.

rows.name: Tourist Attacked by a Bear
rows.notes: A tourist asks you to deal with a black bear.

rows.name: Gasoline Bath
rows.notes: A man fills a bathtub with gasoline at the gas station; it explodes when a car crashes into it.

rows.name: Haunted Bridge
rows.notes: Right after midnight, mist rolls in and you hear a woman crying.

rows.name: Woman in Your Car (dog rescue)
rows.notes: A woman waits in your car and asks for a ride, then asks you to rescue her dog.

rows.name: Tourist Attacked by a Bear
rows.notes: Kill the bear to save the lost tourist from San Fierro.

rows.name: Zeke & Pimple: Target Practice
rows.notes: Two rednecks by the water hold things over their heads for you to shoot.

rows.name: Two Men Fight
rows.notes: Two men fight, jump into a pickup and drive off.

rows.name: Homeless Woman Asks for Money
rows.notes: A homeless woman asks for money: give or refuse.

rows.name: Peeping Tom
rows.notes: Zach peeks through a window at a couple.

rows.name: Gym Junkie
rows.notes: A homeless man naps in your car when you come back from the gym.

rows.name: Jacob's Tavern Robbery
rows.notes: Two Final Chapter MC members rob the bar and throw an employee out of the upstairs window.

rows.name: Helping Hunters
rows.notes: Reward: the Laird 350.

rows.name: Jimmy Figgs Seaplane Base
rows.notes: A seaplane lands and Final Chapter MC bikers collect a stash bag.

rows.name: Festive Poodle
rows.notes: A unique animal behind the Christmas house.

rows.name: Man in the Sewer (DNA)
rows.notes: A man in the sewer looks for his DNA and demands his lawyer.

rows.name: Naked Man Fleeing the Police
rows.notes: A naked man runs away from the police.

rows.name: Lady with Car Trouble
rows.notes: There is loot in her trunk.

rows.name: Choke Challenge (Lucia)
rows.notes: A man asks to be choked; you get $500.

rows.name: Sleeping Cashier
rows.notes: The tired cashier can be robbed by sneaking around the counter.

rows.name: Dumpster Man
rows.notes: Another spot for the dumpster man.

rows.name: Ghost Road
rows.notes: Your car dies and a ghost charges at you, disappears, then dives through the windscreen.

rows.name: UFO Encounter
rows.notes: A car with its hazard lights on faces the forest: walk where the headlights point.

rows.name: Tractor Request
rows.notes: A drunk man needs someone to drive his tractor to his girlfriend's house.

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: A lawyer in a dumpster asks for some medication.

rows.name: Robbed Naked Man
rows.notes: Give him a ride.

rows.name: Plane Drug Deal
rows.notes: A plane lands near the highway and the deal goes wrong: a shootout, with money to take.

rows.name: Finbuster
rows.notes: A man pitches an EMP device. Blow it up, hide the bodies and get the police to leave.

rows.name: Car Crash Stash Bag
rows.notes: A car crashes while fleeing; the dealers run off and leave a stash bag (and weapons).

rows.name: Bear in a Dumpster
rows.notes: A bear in a dumpster jumps out and runs off as you approach.

rows.name: Police Brutality
rows.notes: Two cops beat a man; take out your phone to film them and they tackle and arrest you.

rows.name: Rookie Police Mistake
rows.notes: A woman under arrest breaks through the police car window and runs; the panicked rookie officer shoots his own partner trying to stop her.

rows.name: Hippie AI-CEO
rows.notes: A former AI CEO, free of money worries, does yoga in the park and preaches his gospel.

rows.name: Grocery Store Wrecked
rows.notes: PTT Youngin$ enter a grocery store and wreck it before getting kicked out.

rows.name: Van Crash
rows.notes: A van crashes into a man; help him out.

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: A lawyer pops out of the dumpster to greet you.

rows.name: Drunk Driver Pulled Over
rows.notes: Cops have pulled over a drunk driver; walk up and ask if they have it handled.

rows.name: Primal Man
rows.notes: A feral-looking man eats a deer carcass, green stink coming off him. Get close and he runs screaming into the swamp.

rows.name: Bear Attack
rows.notes: A hiker is attacked by a bear; help him or not.

rows.name: Angry Man on His Car
rows.notes: A man is furious at his car and stands on top of it.

rows.name: Woman Arrested
rows.notes: Two cops arrest a woman, who asks for someone to record it.

rows.name: Streamer Flips His Jet Ski
rows.notes: A streamer flips his jet ski; help him steal a boat.

rows.name: Trip of a Lifetime
rows.notes: Find the open yellow container and eat what is in the egg carton.

rows.name: Sound Advice from a Local
rows.notes: A local meth head gives advice, for a price ($1,116 in cash).

rows.name: Streamer Flips His Jet Ski
rows.notes: WizzyJizz, a content creator, flips his Seashark and asks for a ride for $100, then steals a boat.

rows.name: Scarlet Sun
rows.notes: Meet the psychic Scarlet Sun.

rows.name: Caged Sphynx Cat
rows.notes: Rob the gas station (about $1,000) and find a caged sphynx cat inside: free it or not.

rows.name: M7 Gang Initiation
rows.notes: A victim lies on the ground being beaten. Talk to the victim to learn about the M7 location: Nova Auto Junkyard.

rows.name: High Dealers in a Hotel Room
rows.notes: Two drug dealers high in a hotel room: loot them for about $900 and take their stash to sell.

rows.name: Vagrant Hijacker
rows.notes: A vagrant woman is trying (and failing) to steal a car. You can help her or step in.

rows.name: Robbed at the ATM
rows.notes: A woman sees you using the ATM and tries to talk you into giving her $500. Refuse and she pulls a gun.

rows.name: Snake Attack
rows.notes: A man attacked by a snake by his car.

rows.name: Targeted Man
rows.notes: A man is pinned against the wall by a cop while another searches his car. Talk to him to learn about a robbery opportunity.

rows.name: Cigarette Trick
rows.notes: Give a man a cigarette and he does a trick with it.

rows.name: Living Statue
rows.notes: Across from the gun shop, a little to the side: a woman pretends to be a statue. Give her money or steal her jar; she asks you to warn her if the police show up.

rows.name: Kingfisher Road Crew
rows.notes: On the highway towards the airport, three Kingfisher trucks start chasing you: it ends in a shootout on the bridge.

rows.name: ATM Theft (tow truck)
rows.notes: At night, thieves rip the ATM out with a tow truck.

rows.name: Armored Truck Robbery
rows.notes: Thieves rob an armored truck: you can take the $15,000 bag.

rows.name: Street Race Challenge
rows.notes: A gold car with nitro challenges you to a race.

rows.name: Gang Robbery
rows.notes: Two gang members try to rob you.

rows.name: Loot Exchange
rows.notes: Some men hand over a bag full of stolen goods.

rows.name: Animal Rights Protest
rows.notes: Animal rights protesters, with a man splattered on the sign.

rows.name: Drunk Man and Police
rows.notes: The police take a drunk man away: you can take his car for free.

rows.name: Sofa Help (Manhunt)
rows.notes: A woman needs help loading her sofa onto her pickup truck. Once it is on the truck, a task follows.

rows.name: Man in a Fox Costume
rows.notes: A man in a fox costume under siege from the police: drive up and offer him a ride.

rows.name: Fox House
rows.notes: After saving the man in the fox costume, come here: several guns and body armor to loot.

rows.name: Naked Yoga
rows.notes: Three naked men doing yoga.

rows.name: Bud on the Train Tracks
rows.notes: Bud rants on top of his truck on the train tracks. Something comes crashing down: jump in the truck with him.

rows.name: Weapon Demo
rows.notes: After a shooting range, a man asks you to demo a weapon for his clients.

rows.name: Cannon Smokers
rows.notes: Homeless people smoke weed out of the historic cannon.

rows.name: Car Thieves
rows.notes: People try to steal your car when you park it.

rows.name: Drunken Sailor
rows.notes: A drunk sailor threatens you with a harpoon for cash, then urinates (you can steal his harpoon) and goes back to his boat.

rows.name: Meth Head
rows.notes: At night a meth head appears at the back of the building, asking for money in exchange for bad advice.

rows.name: Deal Gone Wrong
rows.notes: A deal that turns into a bloodbath.

rows.name: Jimmy the Drunk
rows.notes: Jimmy, drunk with a speargun, hangs out at the bar looking for his keys.

rows.name: Car Thieves
rows.notes: People try to steal your car when you park it.

rows.name: Mutant American Crocodile
rows.notes: Lives in the power plant cooling basin.

rows.name: Store Hold-up
rows.notes: A woman holds up the store. Let her leave, then follow her to take the loot and her car.

rows.name: Bear Truck Protest
rows.notes: Protesters stop a truck carrying a bear: you decide whether to free it.

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: A lawyer pops out of a dumpster looking for pills and gives you legal advice; he hints you may see him at another dumpster.

rows.name: Armored Truck Attack
rows.notes: Attack the robbers and take the reward bag ($10,800).

rows.name: Armored Truck Robbery
rows.notes: Armed men rob a money transport.

rows.name: Cop Tied to a Chair
rows.notes: A cop tied to a chair is being beaten: untie him for a Focus boost.

rows.name: The Hunt (sofa trap)
rows.notes: Help the woman with her couch: she knocks you out and you wake up in a container.

rows.name: Corrupt Lawyer
rows.notes: Bring him a bag of cocaine.

rows.name: Criminal Transport
rows.notes: A police car carrying a criminal.

rows.name: Man in a Fox Costume
rows.notes: The police chase a man in a fox costume: offer him a ride to his gang.

rows.name: Man with VR Glasses
rows.notes: Threaten him and he tells you about a safe in the hallway.

rows.name: Store Robbery (woman)
rows.notes: A woman robs the store: you can help with the cash register.

rows.name: Man in a Fox Costume
rows.notes: Around 4:30 am the police track down a man in a fox costume.

rows.name: Finbuster
rows.notes: A man on a fishing boat tosses the Finbuster to your boat; a prompt tells you to throw it into the water.

rows.name: Street Race Challenge (truck)
rows.notes: A truck challenges you to a race; it unlocks more races.

rows.name: Banana Robber
rows.notes: A man tries to rob the convenience store with a banana behind his back instead of a gun: you can call him out.

rows.name: DUI Stop
rows.notes: A woman stopped for DUI: save her from the cops and get money from her father later.

rows.name: Target Practice with Rednecks
rows.notes: Pick up a Duke 556 and do some target practice.

rows.name: Kidnapping
rows.notes: Two men kidnap a man.

rows.name: Attacked by Kolts
rows.notes: The Kolts attack you as you leave the pawn shop.

rows.name: Swamp Witch
rows.notes: The Swamp Witch does breathing exercises and talks about the swamp mother, then asks you to come back in a few days.

rows.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
rows.notes: A van stuck in the mud asks for help.

rows.name: Riot Squad Raid
rows.notes: The riot squad pulls a huge door off and raids the lab.

rows.name: Bear Attack
rows.notes: A man is attacked by a bear: shoot to scare it off and earn reputation.

rows.name: Dog on a Jetski
rows.notes: At night a dog on a jetski picks you up and takes you to a dog party.

rows.name: Runaway Cow
rows.notes: A cow runs away from a farmer.

rows.name: Car Fight
rows.notes: Two men fight because one hit the other's car.

rows.name: Old Man Asks for a Cigarette
rows.notes: An older man by a trailer asks for a cigarette; give him one and he tells you about a San4San studio.

rows.name: Costumed Deer Hunter
rows.notes: A man in a deer costume is shot by his friend, who asks you to take him to the ER.

rows.name: Corrupt Police Officer
rows.notes: A police officer tries to frame a civilian: step in to stop it.

rows.name: Gang Member Assaulted
rows.notes: A gang member is being beaten: step in or walk away.

rows.name: Woman of Nature
rows.notes: A woman talks about connecting with nature and asks you to come back a few days later.

rows.name: Police Search
rows.notes: The police search a suspect in the alley; he asks you to film it and accuses the cops.

rows.name: Unique Bear (tranquilized)
rows.notes: A unique bear with a rope around its neck and a tranq dart in its back roams this area. Hunt it and sell it.

rows.name: Exercise Bike
rows.notes: In front of the house, on the sea side.

rows.name: Sobriety Test
rows.notes: At night the police give a drunk man a sobriety test.

rows.name: Albino Gators
rows.notes: Good for deer, wild boar and albino gators (worth up to $3,650).

rows.name: Target Practice (fire extinguisher)
rows.notes: Shooting a fire extinguisher off a man's head, and more.

rows.name: Bikers Kill a Former Member
rows.notes: Two bikers kill a member who wants to leave: wait for the dialogue options, then shoot them.

rows.name: Bank Robbery
rows.notes: A bank robbery in progress.

rows.name: Cyclist Road Rage
rows.notes: A cyclist wants an apology for being hit: apologize or antagonize him.

rows.name: Parachute (tower)
rows.notes: At the top of the tower.

rows.name: Woman Arrested
rows.notes: A woman being arrested asks you to film it.

rows.name: Albino Alligator
rows.notes: A spawn point of the albino alligator.

rows.name: Bigfoot Scare
rows.notes: A man dressed as Bigfoot startles you while you use the telescope.

rows.name: Woman in Cuffs
rows.notes: A woman in cuffs runs from the cops and they don't chase her. Take her sports car.

rows.name: M7 Beating
rows.notes: The M7 beat up one of their own.

rows.name: Alien Spotting
rows.notes: A car stopped with its doors and trunk open: follow the trail to a naked woman floating.

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: One of the Dumpster Lawyer's spots (second encounter), triggered while being chased by the cops.

rows.name: Just Cheese
rows.notes: A "Karen" has a bad time at the Taco Bomb drive-thru.

rows.name: Ghost Girl
rows.notes: At night (around 9:40 pm) the street goes foggy, your car stalls and a ghost appears.

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: Your lawyer asks you for some pills.

rows.name: Car Crash
rows.notes: A Sahara van crashes into a car; save the man and he gets back in for a lawsuit.

rows.name: I'mma Let You Rock
rows.notes: A man asks for $50; depending on your answer he leaves peacefully.

rows.name: Nude Camp
rows.notes: Nude campers fight you for wearing clothes. Weed in the red bucket.

rows.name: Meth Head Woman
rows.notes: A meth head asks for money in exchange for advice (up to $1,000).

rows.name: Influencer Fell off a Jet Ski
rows.notes: Drop the influencer off near a bridge to earn $100.

rows.name: Drunk Guy on Police Car
rows.notes: At night a drunk man sits on a police car: ask the cops, suggest he is sober for the keys and watch.

rows.name: Bikers About to Kill a Man
rows.notes: Save the man and take the Moreland 850 shotgun from their truck.

rows.name: Tiger in a Cage
rows.notes: Shoot the caged tiger in the head and text Bret Vogel to pick it up.

rows.name: Parachute (climb to the top)
rows.notes: Climb to the very top.

rows.name: Police Chase
rows.notes: The police bust a wanted criminal.

rows.name: Lady Loading a Couch (Hyde Island)
rows.notes: At night, help the lady load her couch: she kidnaps you and takes you to Hyde Island, where you must escape the poacher.

rows.name: Crooked Cops
rows.notes: Police bust a stranger at a traffic stop: you can intervene.

rows.name: Unique Crocodile
rows.notes: A huge unique croc roams here: selling it to Bret Vogel gives an achievement (worth ~$30,000).

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: With jewelry in your stash bag he pops out of this dumpster and asks for some as payment.

rows.name: Kolts Pissing on Your Car
rows.notes: Two Kolts urinate on your parked car.

rows.name: Bear Attack
rows.notes: A standoff between a man and a bear.

rows.name: Uptight Cops
rows.notes: Three cops approach you and want you out of Capri. They are borderline corrupt in their conduct.

rows.name: Sexy Times in Watson Bay
rows.notes: Two men and one woman are heard inside a shed. Rush in and sit down in the chair for a surprise.

rows.name: Kyle Returns
rows.notes: If you finished all of Kyle's missions and let him live, he appears here after killing everyone, leaving easy loot.

rows.name: Scooter Robber
rows.notes: A woman on a mobility scooter robs a man just outside the gun shop.

rows.name: Gang Music Video
rows.notes: Teens filming a music video and flaunting guns get raided by the police.

rows.name: Getaway Fail
rows.notes: There's a couple running away after a heist, but they end up in a car crash. They have quite a stash on them.

rows.name: Dirty Cops
rows.notes: Cops pull over a man with alleged drugs in his car (around 8 pm).

rows.name: Parachute (crane)
rows.notes: On the way up the crane.

rows.name: Shady Shipment
rows.notes: Two guys load up a van near the warehouse. They act shady, when you approach them and begin to hurry. Van has a bit of a sell value due to the cargo.

rows.name: Gas Station Robbery
rows.notes: Two suspects rob the station and run off.

rows.name: Capri Cops Kidnap You
rows.notes: Secret By Invitation Only mission: get a 1- or 2-star wanted level from the Capri police in the town center and surrender. Instead of a normal arrest you wake up in hidden cells: break out, take down the crooked cops, free the prisoners and grab the CPD Moreland 850 from a police car trunk before escaping.

rows.name: Burning Car
rows.notes: A burning car next to a pickup truck with a box on the back.

rows.name: Bridge Jumpers
rows.notes: A few guys challenge you to jump off the bridge if you drive by as a couple. Watch your ride.

rows.name: Drunk Woman Arrested
rows.notes: A drunk woman is arrested by cops.

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: The dumpster lawyer asks you for medication.

rows.name: Dumpster Lawyer
rows.notes: A lawyer in a dumpster asks for drugs and gives advice.

rows.name: ATM Theft
rows.notes: An ATM is being stolen; the thieves flee and you keep the marked bills.

rows.name: Cashier with Asthma
rows.notes: When You try to rob this shop, cashier could have problems with breathing. He asks you to bring him his e-cigarette from the shop storage which helps him to feel better. You can then rob this shop without any problems with Police.

rows.name: Tow Truck Scuffle
rows.notes: A huge guy beats up the tow truck driver. You can intervene and this sweet, pink Tempesta is yours for grabs. It's also wanted by Randy

rows.name: Alien Conspiracy Ranter (2nd encounter)
rows.notes: second encounter with the alien conspiracist, invite you to have a beer then watch a satellite crashed in the nearby hill to the north

rows.name: Pest Shooting Contest
rows.notes: People shoot at targets: talk to them for a target contest, then iguanas are released.

rows.name: Mugging
rows.notes: Two men try to rob you.

rows.name: Gas Station Struggle
rows.notes: Gas Station Struggle: An aspiring car thief at the pumps is having trouble sealing the deal and needs a hand. Decide whether to step in and assist with the heist or leave her stranded. The title is "Gas Station Struggle."

rows.name: Car Broke Down
rows.notes: This guy's car broke down. You can offer him a ride. There's a plot twist though...

rows.name: Bridge Jump & Car Chase
rows.notes: Two people want to jump off a bridge. You then agree that Jason and Lucia should jump. After Jason and Lucia have jumped, the two of them steal your car, leading to a short car chase.

rows.name: Roadside Rollover
rows.notes: A flipped vehicle was spotted along the shoulder of the road, with paramedics attending to the driver at the scene.

rows.name: Lab Explosion
rows.notes: The police find a lab and everything blows up.

rows.name: Skunk Ape Sighting
rows.notes: It eats a deer; if you follow it, you pass out.

rows.name: Palm Reader
rows.notes: Show up at nighttime
